about.title: Jeshua Salazar
about.bio: I hold a degree in Digital Business from Mexico's Instituto Politécnico Nacional. I brought generative AI to PEMEX headquarters, served as a Talent Land ambassador in front of thousands of people, and today I run a complete platform with a team of three people and a team of agents. My mission: that every professional and every company brings AI agents on board as their new employees.

items.q: Do I need to know how to code?
items.a: No. You know your business; I handle the technical side and teach you to lead the agents in plain language.

items.q: Is my company too small for this?
items.a: Quite the opposite. Small teams gain the most: a well-designed agent adds working hours without adding payroll.

items.q: What happens to my company's data?
items.a: Each agent accesses only what it needs, with minimum permissions and a person in charge. Security is designed from day one.
Yes. All the work can be done remotely, in Spanish or English.

aboutPage.title: I build teams where people lead and agents execute.
paragraphs: I'm co-founder and CTO of aiLearning Innovación y Desarrollo Educativo, where I design AI infrastructure and Agent-as-a-Service models for companies and professionals. I hold a degree in Digital Business and a technical degree in Digital Systems from Mexico's Instituto Politécnico Nacional; my thesis studied how AI optimizes digital sales in Social Commerce.

aiLearning is the AI learning platform made in Mexico. Its premise is “Don't learn AI. Master it.”: hands-on training with live classes and real projects across five levels, from Nexo (discover) to Zenit (lead autonomous systems). Since 2024 I've led the build of the platform and its academy, where a team of three people works with AI agents as part of the team. On the commercial side, I led the Social Commerce strategy that filled our events at venues such as CANACO and AMCP, and automated the sales pipeline with AI, cutting lead-management time by up to 80%.

At PEMEX headquarters I used generative AI to write the user stories for the SIMOP traceability project and reduced the team's operational load by 66%; I also designed Power BI dashboards for leadership. For three years I was community leader and ambassador for Talent Land, one of Latin America's largest tech events, in front of audiences of more than 2,000 people. Before that, I managed a private investment fund.
